tasks.title: Start development server
tasks.description: Start the Vite development server to serve the Svelte application

tool.toolDescription: Execute framework commands using Bun runtime

command.expectedOutput: Development server running and serving the Hello World Svelte application

result.output:
<tool_use>
<tool_name>framework_exec</tool_name>
<parameters>
{
  "sessionId": "svelte-hello",
  "action": "dev",
  "framework": "svelte",
  "projectDir": "svelte-hello-world"
}
</parameters>
</tool_use>

I'm starting the Vite development server for the Svelte application. This will:

1. Launch the development server with hot module replacement (HMR)
2. Make the application accessible via a local URL (typically http://localhost:5173)
3. Enable live reloading when files are modified
4. Serve the "Hello World" application that was created and modified in the previous tasks

The `dev` action will run in the background since development servers are long-running processes, allowing you to view the Svelte Hello World application in a browser.
